findings.detail: The pre-attempt caption, printed under the figure before any attempt, states two of the four quantities the stem asks for, and the answer to rung 1. The stem asks for the time to the apex, the velocity at the apex, the acceleration at the apex and the height gained. The caption reads 'Show the launch with u = (12, 20) m/s up to its apex, where only v_y is zero while v_x = 12 m/s continues and gravity still acts.' That gives the apex velocity (12, 0) m/s, the acceleration (gravity, (0, −10) m/s²) and the apex condition v_y = 0, which rung 1 asks for. The previous review filed the same reveal in this representation's <title>. The title is gone, but the reveal is now in visible text, which every learner sees. Use a situation-only caption before the attempt, e.g. 'Show the launch with u_x = 12 m/s and u_y = 20 m/s rising toward the top of its path.' Keep the current wording for the post-attempt mount.

The pre-attempt caption gives the solution route before the attempt, so the four-rung ladder no longer reveals one rung at a time. The caption reads '…the landing is the non-zero root of Δy = 0, and that one time gives the range and the landing velocity.' That is rung 1 (Δy = 0), rung 3 (reuse the landing time in x and v_y) and the key of rung 4 (the non-zero root). The previous review filed the same kind of reveal in this representation's <title> ('… landing where Δy = 0'). Use 'Show the flight with u = (12, 16) m/s and g = 8 m/s² from launch to landing at the same height.' Separately (AUTHOR), rung 2 ('identify Delta y when the projectile returns to its launch height') repeats rung 1 ('What vertical displacement condition is true at a same-height landing?'). Make rung 2 'Write Δy(t) = 16t − 4t² for this launch.'

The third reconstruct prompt does not belong to this attempt: 'If one component equation finds the event time, what time must the other component use?'. The skater task gives t = 4 s; no event time is found from either axis. The rubric line 'Your answer should contain: Two correct component constant-acceleration equations using one t' also leaves out the requested velocity and position. Replace them with 'At t = 4 s, what do v_x = 5 − t and v_y = 2t give, and what do x = 5t − ½t² and y = t² give?' and 'Your answer should contain: a per-axis validity check, the four component equations on one t, and v = (1, 8) m/s, r = (12, 16) m at t = 4 s.' The boat unit's rubric ('A two-column x/y setup with one shared t') likewise omits the (15, 20) m position and the rejected mixed pair that its attempt asks for.

Still open. Gating holds in Chromium: none of the 34 gated disclosures (core1a 3, core1b 6, core2 15, core2a 5, core2b 5) opened on click, Enter or Space without an attempt. An empty or whitespace attempt does not unlock. Hints reveal one rung per click (1 → 2 → 3 → 4, then 'Next hint' is disabled). Stage stepping, the display panel (dark theme, zoom 1.1) and Home (../../../index.html, which exists in public/) work, all 6 Core2B lineage links land on the earlier item, and there are no JS errors, no horizontal overflow and no overlapping figure labels. But any 3 characters ('abc') unlock a unit. The search still filters on article.textContent, including locked answers and post-attempt <desc>: '4.5' shows only Q-PHY-KIN-2D-2B-MODEL-VALIDITY-02, '14.1' only 2B-SAME-HEIGHT-VELOCITY-05, and '48' only 2A-SAME-HEIGHT-05.
